Interface Industry

All Known Implementing Classes:
MixedIndustry, ProducingIndustry, TransformingIndustry
public interface Industry
Common interface for different types of industries in the simulation.

Defines the contract for production, consumption, cost, and location tracking. Implementing classes may represent industries that produce, transform, or handle cargo in various ways.
